profile_text.body:
Runway, founded in 2018 and based in New York, describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world. The company offers products and services built on this intelligence to empower individuals and organizations to do more in the world. Its offerings are powered by GWM-1, described as a state-of-the-art General World Model built to interact with the real world. The company has introduced Solaris, described as an Interface World Model that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame with no code, and positions this as a major step towards universal simulation.

Runway's primary tracked product is Runway, a video generation and editing tool. The company's site highlights enterprise video generation as a focus area, discussing themes including data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution, and model ownership drawn from conversations with enterprise customers.

The company faces multiple lawsuits. Cases include David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in both the District Court of S.D. New York and the District Court of C.D. California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. in the District Court of S.D. New York, and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc. also in the District Court of S.D. New York. New York accounts for 342 cases in the held data.
